title: Finish a desugarer
prompt: An expression is a small tree of dataclasses. desugar returns the same expression with every sugar op replaced by core ops. Neg and Sub are done. The Relu and Fdiv cases still return sugar: make them return max x 0 and mul a (recip b). Desugar the operands too, since sugar can sit inside sugar.
hints: Look at the `Neg` and `Sub` cases. Each returns core nodes built from desugared operands. The `Relu` and `Fdiv` cases still return sugar.
`relu x` means `max x 0`, and `fdiv a b` means `mul a (recip b)`. The zero is `Lit(0.0)`.
`return Max(desugar(a), Lit(0.0))` for `Relu`, and `return Mul(desugar(a), Recip(desugar(b)))` for `Fdiv`.
explain: `relu x` means `max x 0` and `fdiv a b` means `mul a (recip b)`. Each branch calls `desugar` on its operands first, so sugar nested inside sugar is rewritten too. After `desugar`, the tree holds only `add`, `mul`, `max` and `recip`, which every later pass already handles.
